links.outcome: Readability grade level and Flesch Reading Ease of ChatGPT vs OrthoInfo responses on rotator cuff injury
links.effect: ChatGPT average grade level 14.7 vs OrthoInfo 11.9 (p<0.01); Flesch Reading Ease 25.9 vs 52.5 (p<0.01).
links.quote: ChatGPT responses required a higher education level to comprehend, with an average grade level of 14.7, compared to OrthoInfo's 11.9 (p ​< ​0.01).

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and accuracy of ChatGPT-4 responses to rotator cuff FAQs compared to standard web sources without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
